headline: Third quiet day since the export resumed: no analytics rule changed, 1,311 detectors unmoved
summary_md:
- **Nothing changed.** The export ran and touched no file under `analytics/` — nothing added, withdrawn or edited.
- The reference holds at **1,311 detectors**, the count the run marker has carried unchanged since the 6 September export.
- Third consecutive quiet day since the export resumed on 30 September, after the three-week gap with no analytics run at all.
- The last movement in the reference remains 6 September, which touched 302 files.
